prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 86.6%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 94.6%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 72.3%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 93.0%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Pet Behavior Soundboard Stage: Redesign the pick_friend screen into an interactive soundboard stage where users can click pet reaction cards to play sample audio and behavior previews before adopting. (why: Adoption step has a low conversion rate (72.3%) and a long median time (89s), showing users need an engaging and immediate preview of pet personality.)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Display Mode Calibration Screen: Insert a dedicated desktop display test screen right after render waiting that verifies overlay visibility and multi-monitor position before going home. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets failing to appear on desktop or the desktop view stalling on launch.)
2: [sign_in, new_flow] Account Sync & Pet Memory Protection Flow: Introduce a state-preservation sub-flow on sign-in that explicitly checks and preserves active local pet profiles prior to cloud authentication. (why: 8 support emails were received about pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
3: [home, wait_info] Interactive Pet Trait Deck During Render: Provide an interactive carousel tip deck on the render waiting screen showing control tricks and sound cues while assets compile in the background. (why: Waiting step takes median 201s and mean 2336s, leading to drop-offs and subsequent support confusion about controls.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop Tray Notification Sound Alert: Trigger a subtle notification chime and taskbar highlight when render completion finishes in the background. (why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s, indicating users tab away from the desktop app and forget to complete setup.)
5: [finish, layout] Desktop Control Hotkey Cheat Sheet Grid: Reformat home_intro into a two-column grid showcasing system tray controls and hotkeys for hiding and interacting with the pet. (why: 3 support emails asked how to control, hide, or converse with the pet after completing onboarding.)
6: [choose_path, hint] Path Decision Safety Guarantee Badge: Display a hint confirming that users can switch, create, or adopt additional pets at any time from app settings. (why: An extreme mean time of 514s on choose_path suggests hesitation due to fear of making an irreversible choice.)
